Evan / Kim — attaching the retention matrix (see attachment) and a few technical clarifications: 

- "Request/response traces" = short-lived KV + request headers and routed payload metadata; default TTL 30 days, can extend to 90 or 365 via account configuration. We do not retain full customer prompt/response payloads beyond 30 days by default unless explicitly requested under a contractually-scoped "exception".
- "System debug logs" (node-level, scheduler, runtime) are collected for 90 days in hot storage and moved to cold archival buckets for 2 years for forensic purposes; retention beyond 2 years currently requires legal/ops approval.
- Backups: encrypted snapshots of model-serving state + configuration are retained separately from request logs. Snapshot retention is 180 days by default; we can change for RiverMark to 365 days in the addendum if required.

Important: For any exception that increases retention of PII or customer payloads, we will require a signed addendum and a security review to confirm encryption-at-rest scope and key management.
